items.description: The southeastern hills form a rugged landscape that defines the topography of Trinidad's southern coastal region.
Aripo Valley is characterized by its rolling terrain and lush greenery, situated within the northern part of Trinidad.
The Caroni Plain is a broad, flat expanse that serves as a vital agricultural heartland for the island.
The Nariva Swamp basin is a significant lowland area, central to the natural drainage and wetland topography of eastern Trinidad.
The Columbus Channel features a complex marine topography, separating Trinidad from the South American mainland.
The lowlands of Guayaguayare encompass coastal plains that are integral to the southeastern geographic character of the island.
The dramatic cliffs of the Paria coast define the rugged and scenic northern shoreline of Trinidad.
Madamas Valley is a picturesque interior lowland, set within the lush mountainous landscape of northern Trinidad.
The slopes of Blanchisseuse represent the steep and scenic transition between the Northern Range mountains and the Caribbean sea.
The Gran Couva highlands form a central, hilly region known for its elevated terrain and agricultural heritage.
